description: This file contains utility functions for managing CUDA and HIP libraries, error checking, module loading, and device index retrieval within the PyTorch framework, specifically for GPU operations.

classes.name: _CudaModule
classes.description: Represents a loaded CUDA module with access to its kernels.

classes.name: _CudaKernel
classes.description: Represents a CUDA kernel that can be launched with specified parameters.

methods.name: _get_hip_runtime_library
methods.description: Loads the HIP runtime library, either via ROCm SDK or system library.

methods.name: _get_cuda_library
methods.description: Loads the CUDA driver library on Unix or Windows.

methods.name: _get_gpu_runtime_library
methods.description: Returns the appropriate GPU runtime library depending on whether HIP or CUDA is used.

methods.name: _check_cuda
methods.description: Checks the result of a CUDA operation and raises an error if it failed.

methods.name: _get_hiprtc_library
methods.description: Loads the HIP RTC library, either via ROCm SDK or system library.

methods.name: _get_nvrtc_library
methods.description: Loads the NVRTC library based on CUDA version and platform.

methods.name: _get_gpu_rtc_library
methods.description: Returns the appropriate GPU RTC library depending on HIP or CUDA.

methods.name: _get_gpu_rtc_compatible_flags
methods.description: Provides a list of compiler flags compatible with NVRTC for HIP or CUDA.

methods.name: _nvrtc_compile
methods.description: Compiles a CUDA kernel source code into PTX using NVRTC, returning the PTX and mangled name.

methods.name: _cuda_load_module
methods.description: Loads a CUDA module from PTX code and provides access to its kernels.

methods.name: _get_device_index
methods.description: Retrieves the device index from a device object, integer, or None, considering optional and CPU allowances.
